summary: The fix for R1-1 makes the optional `(default ...)` tail of the reader's docs regex greedy up to the last `)` on the line, so a default that contains a parenthesis no longer ends up in the doc. I traced it on the new `ENV=<name>` form, the pre-#18 `ENV=identifier` form and the hand-written line with no default, and each gives the doc alone. The two new setup-test cases cover both header forms, and the first one also checks that the default reads back whole from the assignment line. One limit carries over unchanged from main: the lazy doc group still stops at the first ` (default ` on the line, so a doc that itself contains that phrase gets cut short. This fix diff did not introduce that, so it is not reported. No scheduled or queued work touches these files.
